prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized orca shaman seen from the side, body in profile, centered.
Flat app-icon geometry. The body is a confident saturated dark palette
color (deep navy or near-black). White ritual scar-lines carved across
the flank and snout, rendered as simple flat white curves (not ink
marks) — three to five parallel bands. A small white oval for the eye-
patch. Body posture is calm / ceremonial, tail fluke level. No
weapons, no relics — identity comes from the scar markings alone.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat app-icon illustration; bold vector geometry; modern UI icon register — Phosphor Fill / SF Symbols Filled aesthetic; centered single-subject composition on plain off-white canvas with generous padding; crisp sharp edges readable at 16px
SUBJECT: adult orca in strict side profile, lean anatomically correct body, calm ceremonial posture with tail fluke held level; body filled solid deep navy (#000000 near-black with blue undertone); a small flat white (#FFFFFF) oval eye-patch shape positioned correctly on the head; three to five flat white (#FFFFFF) parallel curved bands crossing the flank and snout as ritual scar-lines — rendered as clean geometric curves, not brushstrokes; no weapons, no relics, identity from markings alone
CONTEXT: isolated icon asset, no background scene, no ground plane, no setting elements; subject floats centered on off-white canvas
COLOR: body in deep navy-black (#000000); scar-line bands and eye-patch in pure flat white (#FFFFFF); off-white (#FFFFFF near-neutral) canvas ground; strong maximum contrast between orca silhouette and mark shapes
DETAILS: every edge crisp vector-sharp; scar bands are uniform-weight flat fills, not tapered or brushy; eye-patch a clean filled oval; silhouette bold enough to read as a single confident shape at 32px and 16px; anatomy adult proportions — elongated torpedo body, narrow rostrum, correct dorsal fin placement
CONSTRAINTS: flat fills only; no gradients; no textures; no brushwork; no grain; no weathering; no painterly rendering; no cartoon or juvenile proportions
